test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statement is INCORRECT about simple permanent tissue?

options.text: It founds few layers beneath the epidermis
Food storage occurs in simple permanent tissue
Simple permanent tissue is generally composed of living cells
Sclerenchyma is the most common simple permanent tissue

solution:
p-data-start="0">The correct answer is __**Sclerenchyma is the most common simple permanent tissue**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Simple permanent tissues** are a group of cells that are similar in origin, structure, and function. They are primarily classified into three types: **Parenchyma**, **Collenchyma**, and **Sclerenchyma**.
 
• These tissues are typically found **a few layers beneath the epidermis** in plant organs such as stems and roots. For instance, the **hypodermis** and **cortex** are often composed of these tissues. ***Hence, statement 1 is correct.***
 
• One of the primary functions of simple permanent tissue, specifically **Parenchyma**, is **food storage**. These cells contain large vacuoles and may store nutrients in the form of starch, oils, or proteins. ***Hence, statement 2 is correct.***
 
• Simple permanent tissues like **Parenchyma** and **Collenchyma** are generally composed of **living cells** with thin or marginally thickened primary cell walls
